description: This file defines the SequenceUtil class, which provides utility methods for managing and generating unique sequence IDs from named sequence banks within a database, including thread-safe bank filling and transaction management.

classes.name: SequenceUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing sequences and sequence banks, supporting thread-safe ID generation and dynamic bank resizing.

classes.name: SequenceUtil.SequenceBank
classes.description: Inner class representing a sequence bank that manages ranges of sequence IDs, handling database locking, updating, and synchronization.

methods.name: SequenceUtil
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SequenceUtil with helper info, sequence entity, and field names.

methods.name: getNextSeqId
methods.description: Returns the next sequence ID for a given sequence name, with optional staggering.

methods.name: forceBankRefresh
methods.description: Forcefully refreshes the sequence bank for a given sequence name.

methods.name: getBank
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a sequence bank for a given sequence name.

methods.name: SequenceBank.getNextSeqId
methods.description: Thread-safe method to obtain the next sequence ID within the current bank, refilling the bank if necessary.

methods.name: SequenceBank.refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the bank by syncing with the database and updating sequence boundaries.

methods.name: SequenceBank.fillBank
methods.description: Fills the sequence bank with new range of IDs from the database, handling locking and updates within a transaction.
